# Cash4HomeFL — Business and website reference

## Business

Cash4HomeFL buys residential property for cash in Palm Beach County and Broward County, Florida. Homeowners can request an offer for a home in its current condition. Cash4HomeFL describes itself as a private cash buyer, not a licensed real estate broker.

Website: https://cash4homefl.com
Phone: (561) 220-9399
Email: hello@cash4homefl.com
Contact page: https://cash4homefl.com/contact
About: https://cash4homefl.com/about

## Selling process

1. The homeowner provides the property address and contact information.
2. The buyer reviews the property, condition and local market before making an offer.
3. The homeowner decides whether to accept the offer.
4. If both parties agree, they arrange closing on an agreed timeline.

The website describes as-is purchases without repairs or realtor commissions. Offer amounts, eligibility, closing dates and other transaction terms require direct confirmation with the business; submitting an inquiry does not establish a purchase agreement.

Process overview: https://cash4homefl.com/we-buy-houses
Fast-sale information: https://cash4homefl.com/sell-my-house-fast
Frequently asked questions: https://cash4homefl.com/faq
